advisories.reason: expo-router 57 -> query-string 7 -> decode-uri-component 0.2.2. Reached when the router parses a URL query string, so a crafted link can freeze the tab or app of the person who opens it. No server impact and no data exposure. The patched release (0.5.1) is ESM-only and cannot be forced under query-string 7; the fix is expo-router 58 (Expo SDK 58 upgrade, docs/NEXT_STEPS.md 1.5). The related moderate advisory GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr has the same path and fix.

react-native -> @react-native/community-cli-plugin -> metro -> image-size 1.2.1. Metro reads the size of our own bundled images at build time; it never runs in the shipped app and never sees user uploads. Metro pins image-size ^1, and no patched 1.x exists.
